text: RegLegalTech startups will force the legal profession to innovate, but that task is not easily accomplished by overextended and cumbersome legal organizations that have lost the capacity for agile reinvention.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - Past, Present, and Future (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411897
abstract: Second, and most importantly, the legal profession will be forced by such startup companies to innovate, a task that is not easily accomplished by overextended, and often cumbersome, legal organizations that have lost the capacity for agile reinvention.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to incumbent legal organizations facing RegLegalTech entrants
